enabledDesc: Convert LaTeX delimiters into SiYuan formulas when pasting
keepHtmlDesc: When formulas are detected, content copied from web pages or Word is converted to Markdown first, keeping bold, lists and links. Disable to handle plain-text pastes only.
displayDesc: Convert to $$ … $$ when on its own line, fall back to inline when inside a paragraph
bareDesc: Treat lines of undelimited LaTeX as display formulas. May misdetect normal text.
markdownMathDesc: Also parse $x^2+1=y$ as formulas — pastes carrying HTML would otherwise keep them as plain text
copyAsMarkdownDesc: When copying formulas out of SiYuan, restore the $ delimiters so Obsidian, Typora and friends render them as math again
debugDesc: Log every paste to the browser console and show a toast on load. Turn off once everything works.
